title: AI Artist Xania Monet Climbs the Charts — And Signs a Multimillion-Dollar Record Deal (Billboard)
notes: Billboard (domain authority), Hannah Karp, 2025-09-16. Xania Monet (Telisha Jones, Mississippi) uses Suno; $3M Hallwood Media (Neil Jacobson) deal; first Billboard charts wk of 2025-09-20 (No.25 Emerging Artists, No.21 Hot Gospel); 'How Was I Supposed to Know' No.1 R&B Digital Sales; 9.8M US on-demand streams (Luminate), 5.4M in one week. R&B/gospel, not strictly hip-hop.
